# Flows

> Flows distribute protocol-generated value to applications, markets and integrations building on top of Polaris.

Canonical URL: https://docs.polaris.finance/architecture/flows
Markdown URL: https://docs.polaris.finance/architecture/flows.md
Section: Core Architecture

Documentation index: https://docs.polaris.finance/llms.txt
Full documentation bundle: https://docs.polaris.finance/llms-full.txt

---

Flows distribute protocol-generated value throughout the Polaris ecosystem.

These incentive streams sit one layer above the [Fee Router](https://docs.polaris.finance/design/fee-router), which first processes pETH-denominated protocol revenue through the bonding curve. Flows then determine where the resulting pETH rewards are sent.

Instead, pAsset flows operate separately. Interest paid by minters of assets such as USDp or GOLDp does not pass through the Fee Router, and is instead distributed through that pAsset market's own flow logic.

Thus, **ecosystem incentives are paid out using assets directly connected to protocol activity**, without relying on inflationary POLAR emissions.

Interest paid by pAsset minters is distributed by each market's own flow logic to Earn Pools, sPOLAR holders and approved integrations.](https://docs.polaris.finance/videos/flows-poster.jpg)

## Flow Allocation

pETH flows are shared among whitelisted recipients according to the value each one reports holding, such as the total collateral of a pAsset market, multiplied by a weighting set by stewardship. Stewardship can also set a minimum value for a recipient, so a new market or integration receives a meaningful share before it has grown. The main recipients are pAsset markets, which share their pETH among their positions in proportion to debt.

Instead, stewardship sets the share of each pAsset flow recipient directly, within the minimums enforced onchain.

Since minimum values distribute protocol value before a recipient has earned it through normal usage, they are managed through stewardship and should only be used where **the recipient is expected to create value for Polaris**.

## pETH and pAssets Flows

**pETH flows are funded by bonding curve swap fees, pETH-to-POLAR conversions and Floor Loan fees.** Swap fees and converted pETH are burned at the floor price, which raises the floor and releases ETH from the reserve. That ETH, together with Floor Loan fees, which are already paid in ETH, buys new pETH on the bonding curve, which is then distributed through pETH flows.

**Each pAsset market also generates its own independent flow** funded by the interest paid by users who mint that specific pAsset, such as USDp or GOLDp.

Unlike pETH flows, pAsset flows do not pass through the Fee Router. Each market routes a protocol-defined minimum allocation to its corresponding Earn Pool, which for USDp and GOLDp is 25%, while at least 20% goes to sPOLAR. Future pAsset markets may choose to share revenue with sPOLAR as part of their alignment strategy and their case for receiving pETH flows.

The remaining flow can then be distributed to approved recipients building around that pAsset, including liquidity pools, vaults, structured products and other integrations.

Flow type | Funded by | Distribution

pETH flows | Bonding curve swap fees, Floor Loan fees, pETH→POLAR conversions | Processed by the Fee Router, then distributed as pETH
pAsset flows | Interest paid by pAsset minters | Distributed by each pAsset market's flow logic

## Stewardship Role

Once configured, **flows operate automatically through immutable protocol rules**.

Stewardship determines:

- Which contracts are eligible to receive flows
- Which address receives them
- Any additional weighting applied to each recipient
- Any minimum value applied to a recipient

Recipients are expected to create value for Polaris in return for flow support. That value may come through liquidity, integrations, revenue sharing or other forms of ecosystem growth.
